response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers reasonable and necessary medical expenses, including treatment for acute injuries incurred during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (A5.1 would apply if it were), and the treatment was not planned in advance (A5.2 would apply if it were)."}
